watchlist.thesis: Allstate remains in a positive 10- and 20-session trend and held within 0.24% of its Nov 13 close while SPY fell 8.56%, but its Nov 20 close was 0.90% below VWAP, so a reclaim is needed before entry.
Royalty Pharma is up 7.19% over 20 sessions, remains 1.27% above its 20-day average and closed marginally above VWAP, while softening quarterly growth argues for confirmation rather than chasing.
Procter & Gamble is up 5.19% over 20 sessions and 2.04% above its 20-day average in the most resilient sector group, but its 0.72x current ratio and close below VWAP warrant conservative risk limits.

sector_notes: Market breadth was decisively risk-off on Nov 20: 80.5% of 3,140 stocks priced at least $5 and trading at least 500,000 shares closed below their open, while SPY lost 8.56% and QQQ 10.51% over Nov 13–20. Consumer staples and utilities were the relative havens (XLP -2.05%, XLU -3.07% for the week), while technology and semiconductors led the drawdown (XLK -12.49%, SMH -17.8%). Keep exposure selective and favor names still above their 20-day averages; the AI and semiconductor unwind is not yet a confirmed bottom.
